# Field crafting and inhalers
Use whole items and plant materials for these recipes, rather than measured chemical extracts. Open the crafting menu and choose the medical category. Amounts are item or material counts.
## Mortar & pestle
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 2 x wood plank.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] A tool for processing ingredients; it is not medicine. ## Healing powder
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x broc flower + 1 x xander root.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies healing powder haze; Applies recovery status; Heals burn, brute damage; Reduces bleeding; At 30u or more: Can cause vomiting; Suppresses chronic pain. ## Cleansing powder
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x irradiated cave fungus + 1 x xander root.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation damage; Reduces feralization progression; Applies drowsiness. ## Berserker powder
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x Wild White Horsenettle + 1 x Nettles + 1 x Wild Glowpepper + 1 x xander root + 1 x broc flower.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals burn, brute damage; Reduces bleeding; Increases movement speed; Applies seeing rainbows; At 5u or more: Removes stun; At 5u or more: Removes knockdown; At 26u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage. ## Stimpak
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x broc flower + 1 x xander root + 1 x empty syringe + 1 x bloodpack.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; Reduces bleeding; At 30u or more: Can cause vomiting. ## Jet inhaler
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x Plastic.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] An empty inhaler body. Fill or assemble it before use. ## Dirty gauze
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 2 x Cloth.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals slash, piercing, burn damage; Causes poison damage; Reduces bleeding. Apply to the patient; this is the field item, not the similarly named reagent. ## Healing poultice
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x broc flower + 1 x xander root + 1 x Cave Fungus + 1 x agave leaf.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies recovery status; Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; Reduces bleeding; Causes jittering; At 26u or more: Can cause vomiting; At 30u or more: Causes poison damage. ## Datura hide
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 4 x Datura Flower + 1 x Wonderglue.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals heat, shock, caustic, cold damage. Apply to the patient; this is the field item, not the similarly named reagent. ## Snakebite tourniquet
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x Wild Buffalo Gourd + 1 x Cloth + 1 x Plastic.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison damage; Causes brute damage; Reduces bleeding. Apply to the patient; this is the field item, not the similarly named reagent. ## Fiery purgative
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x ethanol bottle + 1 x Wild Glowpepper + 1 x Wild White Horsenettle.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison, radiation damage; Causes heat damage; Removes cazador venom in the body; Removes nightstalker venom in the body; Removes ash viper venom in the body; Reduces movement speed; Can cause vomiting. ## Blood shield
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 2 x Barrel Cactus Fruit + 2 x Cave Fungus + 2 x broc flower.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn, poison damage. ## Pilgrim's remedy
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x broc flower + 1 x xander root + 1 x Cave Fungus + 1 x agave leaf + 1 x Datura Flower.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn, poison, radiation damage; Increases bleeding; Reduces feralization progression. ## Healing salve
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x broc flower + 1 x xander root + 1 x agave leaf.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals slash, piercing, blunt damage; Reduces bleeding. Apply to the patient; this is the field item, not the similarly named reagent. ## Gravesalt
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x Ash + 1 x Cave Fungus + 2 x Wild White Horsenettle + 1 x agave leaf.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes ghostcap extract in the body; Removes widow's mercy in the body; Removes red bell poison in the body; Removes ash viper venom in the body; Removes cazador venom in the body; Removes nightstalker venom in the body; Heals poison, asphyxiation damage; Causes brute damage; Can cause vomiting. ## Glowing blood pack
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x bloodpack + 2 x irradiated cave fungus + 1 x ethanol bottle.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn, asphyxiation, bloodloss damage; Applies incoming radiation protection. ## Herbal anodyne
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 2 x Wild Carrot + 1 x irradiated cave fungus + 2 x Nettles + 1 x Wild White Horsenettle + 1 x agave leaf.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals burn, blunt damage. Apply to the patient; this is the field item, not the similarly named reagent. ## Herbal antimicrobial
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x Wild Carrot + 1 x irradiated cave fungus + 2 x Wild Buffalo Gourd + 1 x Nettles + 1 x agave leaf.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals caustic, heat, poison damage. Apply to the patient; this is the field item, not the similarly named reagent. ## Herbal stimulant
[bold]Requires:[/bold] 1 x irradiated cave fungus + 1 x Wild Buffalo Gourd + 1 x Nettles + 2 x Wild White Horsenettle.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes drowsiness; Increases movement speed. ## Hydra inhaler
Mix 1u scorpion tail + 1u fungus extract + 1u nightstalker blood to make 2u Hydra. Prepare at least 15u, transfer it into an empty Hydra inhaler, and use a screwdriver on the filled inhaler to seal it. This finishing step is performed on the item in-world, not through a visible crafting-menu recipe.
[bold]Effects of Hydra:[/bold] Applies incoming damage protection; Can cause addiction; Causes jittering; At 22u or more: Causes asphyxiation damage.
## RadAway inhaler
Craft a Jet inhaler body from 1 plastic. Fill an empty RadAway phial with at least 30u RadAway, then seal it with a screwdriver. Attach the finished RadAway phial to the inhaler body using the RadAway inhaler crafting recipe.
[bold]Effects of RadAway:[/bold] Heals radiation damage; Reduces feralization progression.
## Bitterdrink
The old whole-plant bitterdrink recipe is disabled. Use the heated chemistry recipe in Core mixtures, then the bottle conversion in Finishing medicine.
